decisions.title: Thornbound: 5 rule mismatches need your call
decisions.detail: The worker found 5 places where the game and the rules notes disagree. Tell me for each: follow the rules notes, or keep the game as is.

notes.text: LIVE and verified (site files match the build): 22 games with credits removed + fixes (Wildmark readability, Perch clarity, Sands claims/paths, Thornbound tutorial); previews: Wickdeep redesign, Ochre guide, Via Tessera, Onyx Atelier, Meadowfold, Gloamwar (still Preview, not called finished). NOT live: Twin Thrones (old version stays; a fix worker for its board layout check is running).

WEEKLY METER (owner: 9% used at this time): my measured estimate since 22:26 UTC is at least $52, so 1% of the weekly limit is roughly $5.8 of estimate and the whole week about $580 (rough; the old orchestrator's unknown share makes it a bit lower). Burn so far about $17 per hour with many workers running: at that pace the weekly limit would be reached in about 1.5 days, before the reset. The week resets Mon 30 Nov 22:00 UTC.

EXACT COST SINCE 22:26 UTC (measured, as reported by each session): workers $32.73 (26 workers, all finished ones exact) + this orchestrator $14.68 + old orchestrator at least $4.71 = about $52.1 at the very least. Not yet counted: Twin Thrones rules worker and Credits B (rerun) worker, which are still running and report their cost only when they finish a turn; and whatever the old orchestrator spent between 22:26 and 23:10. These are API-price estimates; your plan's weekly % is computed differently by Anthropic.

Workers finished (not yet live): Wickdeep redesign, Ochre guide, Gloamwar, Onyx Atelier, Meadowfold, Thornbound tutorial. Still working: Via Tessera, Twin Thrones rules. Credits group B was blocked and needs a rerun. A fresh full rebuild of all games is running; nothing new is live until it passes my own phone and PC check. Costs of the newest finished workers are not counted yet.
